title: Your data
subtitle: Download a copy or delete the account

export.title: Download my data
export.text: A JSON file with everything wordloop keeps about you: profile, passkeys (name and dates only), sessions, preferences, goals, study and your answer history. It does not include passwords or keys.
export.failed: I couldn't download right now. Try again.

erase.title: Delete my account
erase.text: Erases right away and for good:

items.account: your profile, your sign-in links, your passkeys and your sessions
items.study: your preferences, goals, cards and study days

erase.irreversible: There is no way back. If you want, download a copy of your data first.
erase.dialogText: Everything will be erased now and it cannot be undone. To confirm, type your account e-mail.
erase.relogin: Sign out and sign in again

errors.mismatch: The e-mail you typed is not the account e-mail.
errors.admin: Administrator accounts cannot be deleted here.
errors.recent: For security, sign in again and repeat the request.
errors.session: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.failed: I couldn't delete right now. Nothing was erased. Try again.
